checkpoint: minimum clean permitted training-RX equal validation CE
history: All RXs have research history; none becomes a fresh independent acquisition.
launch_condition: A complete evidence report first; no automatic execution in this turn. Any later launch must retain this plan, validate checkpoints/streams and commit its execution authorization before source fitting.

new_readout.width_rule: Hidden width128 is nearest integer matching 16768 to129*h+192; chosen without data.
new_readout.limits: No token interaction until pooling; MLP nonlinear depth differs; capacity and compute are not identical. Interaction is a backend-specific accuracy contrast, not identification of encoded information.

initialization: Surviving frontend/tokenizer/input_proj/position/LNs/classifier match each corresponding original initialization. Identical new MLP heads acrossH0/LP use CPU stable_seed(S27B-Readout,data_seed), preserve other RNG.
source_packets: Original5RX/fold,8000train2000sourceval. Same frozen selected rows/labels and source order asS26.
reuse: SixH0 and sixS26LP MHA checkpoints are legal only after exact checkpoint/config/source-stream/precision recovery; no MHA refitting.

statistics.pairing: samefold/seed/RX in all4 cells; first average3seeds within each of10uniqueRX
statistics.positive_signal: interaction mean>=0.5pp,conditional lowerCI>0,>=5/6positive fit interactions,both fold means positive
statistics.uncertainty: Conditional on historical models, chosen nonattention readout and current10RX; no fresh acquisition or architecture search uncertainty.

outcomes.positive: H0 relative benefit is larger for this MHA backend than this MLP backend; not universal attention necessity.
outcomes.negative: No stable positive interaction; tokenizer gain may persist without attention or depend on another factor.
outcomes.uncertain: Mixedfit/fold signs or small effects: report all4 cells and intervals; no alternativehead search.
